rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line.
notes: $db is an untyped property → db.table (last receiver segment), low. The later links are on call results → .where/.get, low. Each on its own name's line (C7). call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
